rows.title: Wrap-Up and Conclusive Discussion on Key Takeaways
rows.speaker: yaniv
text: The purpose of this session is to summarize the main conclusions from participants' feedback as well as oral comments and remarks. We will attempt to identify key opportunities for implementation, both at the individual and collective community levels. Attendees will be invited to line up for sharing concluding remarks and takeaways in a few minutes per participant.
